title: Local uploads appear in the workspace /uploads mount

steps.instructions: Open More workspace actions and choose Upload file. Generate a deterministic 20 MiB local fixture named qa-upload.bin under artifacts/qa/workspace.uploads and select it with Chrome DevTools DOM.setFileInputFiles. Verify POST uploads is 201, direct GCS PUTs include multiple chunks and complete, and the dialog shows Uploaded to /uploads/qa-upload.bin. Capture no session URLs or tokens.
Close the dialog, set the viewport to 390x844, and open More workspace actions. Verify Upload file opens the same dialog. Restore the desktop viewport.

Start this disposable workspace from Workspace power controls. Using its authenticated shell, verify /uploads/qa-upload.bin has the same size and SHA-256 as the local fixture and that /uploads is read-only. Stop/start and repeat the checksum check. Never execute checks in another workspace.

Verify an oversized local File is rejected without an API call; in focused tests verify duplicate names, path traversal, ownership, interrupted transfer retries, and cancel behavior. Keep intentional error checks separate from the clean success-flow console evidence.
